description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Sets a brand's legal name, registered address, currency (ISO, like USD) and/or timezone (IANA, like America/New_York). Only the fields sent change; a brand with no details yet needs all four. Do not send a tax id: it is refused. A brand owner or admin adds it in flayr (Brand › Overview).
(Wraps PATCH /api/v2/brands/{id}/business-details.)

id.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. A brand-bound key may only name its own brand (another brand → 403).

registeredAddress.description: Replaced as a whole when sent.

name: brand_business_details_update
title: Update a brand's business details
